scope: Train sources only. Explicit reviewed rectangular ROIs; all pixels outside ROI are unlabelled, never background. No training, oversampling or runtime changes. Existing source reviews are not counted as new referee observations.
annotation_method: Role-blind COCO11n person proposals, sorted by centre x then top y, plus original native dataset boxes. Agent assigns roles from raw images; no trained role-detector output used. Model-assisted boxes, no independent second reviewer.
